title: Jets fall short in 24-16 loss to Buccaneers in preseason opener

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets fall short in 24-16 loss to Buccaneers in preseason opener
sources.description: In a game with not much star power on display, the Jets and Buccaneers each got their preseason campaigns underway with Tampa Bay outlasting New York 24-16 on Friday night.
